finding.mechanism: The current offset-only incremental scanner resets local_line on each ingest_artifact_history resume while source_event_identity hashes line_no. The same physical workers.jsonl record can therefore receive different source_event_id values under different replay partitioning. The active backlog-first Forge calls source-count reconciliation after ingestion and uses source_count as a scheduling tie-breaker.
finding.risk: COUNT(DISTINCT source_event_id) is not an admissible provenance-weight estimate until source-event identity is replay-partition invariant.

hypothesis: A conservative scheduling lower bound prevents artificial provenance amplification until the absolute-line checkpoint is fused.
counterhypothesis_disposition: REJECTED: candidate insertion can already increase source_count when partition-sensitive replay produces a new synthetic source_event_id, so a no-op reconciliation can preserve or accumulate distorted weight.

delta.fail_closed_rule: If backfill_files.line_no is absent, linked candidates are clamped to source_count=1. If line_no is present, source_count may be reconciled to COUNT(DISTINCT source_event_id). Unlinked legacy candidates remain untouched.
delta.automatic_reenable: The gate derives readiness from the additive backfill_files.line_no schema marker; it does not require a second product/state/effect authority.
